fact: The report states Senegal has had a national identification system since law n°1962-14 of 20 February 1962 instituting a national identity card, and that replacement of old cards had deadlines of 31 December 2019 (Dakar) and 27 July 2020 (other regions).
title: Revue du cadre juridique pour l'identité numérique nationale (rapport intermédiaire, GAINDE 2000 / MENTI / PNUD)
